scenario_note: The scene is the rung R4 geometry of ADR 0033 drawn at a fleet that is at R0; its four gateways, 110 nodes, two plumes and every link are simulated; the estimator models one source; node ids beyond 14 ride RAW_SENSOR_V2, which no firmware emits yet.

/api/map/posterior?site=monterrey-metro&.label: provisional / unrefined (ADR 0018) · r90 is a posterior radius, not CEP
/api/map/posterior?site=monterrey-metro&.model: isotropic 1/r lattice over source_strength (1000.0, 3000.0, 10000.0, 30000.0, 100000.0, 300000.0, 1000000.0) (wind-free default, ADR 0018 §1)

interception.note: nodes whose excess over their baseline exceeded 3 σ_abs at least once

caveats: unrefined grid likelihood over the logged frames — the scored reference is the offline estimate (ADR 0018 item 3)
r90 is the radius about the MAP holding 90 % of this posterior, not CEP-90 (a percentile of errors across trials)
entropy measures how sure the estimator is, never whether it is right (T1 finding 3)
MAP and mean are both drawn: on an annulus likelihood the mean sits where the source is not
origin = centre — not a surveyed source; errors are not scoreable
receptors within 100 m of the source inherit the ISC3 Briggs caution
grid 101×101 at 500 m cells over ±25000 m
